about: The deck visual checklist: one entry per check. kind yes_no answers yes, no or n/a; kind metric answers a value or n/a. n/a is never a pass. bench/checklist.py holds one function per id. Thresholds read from spec, theme or qa_render are named in the source, not copied.

items.question: Is no blocker left: no finding at level error in validation.json or qa.json?
items.source: docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §7: with no policy severity entry, error is blocker and warn is minor (policy/repair.yaml does not exist until deck-repair-loop; when it does, its severity map is used)
items.na_when: validation.json is missing or is not a list; or qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Does validation.json hold no error?
items.source: validate.py: level error fails the run's gate (ADR 0016)
items.na_when: validation.json is missing or is not a list

items.question: Does qa.json hold no error on a presented slide?
items.source: qa_render.py levels; contract §7 default mapping
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Is no major left?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §2.7 severity defaults; docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §7 and §8
items.na_when: no repair policy with a severity map exists (engine/deck/policy/repair.yaml, deck-repair-loop): without one nothing is major, so the answer is unjudgeable, not yes

items.question: Were the checks run on this exact deck.json (qa.deck_sha equals the deck's hash)?
items.source: docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §7 (deck_sha, current); PPTAgent's hash-gated finish (Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §6)
items.na_when: qa.json carries no deck_sha (today's qa_render writes none; deck-repair-loop adds it)

items.question: Is no presented slide's text running past its frame or off the slide (text_overflow)?
items.source: qa_render.py text_overflow
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Does no text overlap other text on a presented slide (text_overlap)?
items.source: qa_render.py text_overlap
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Does every shape stay on the slide (off_slide)?
items.source: qa_render.py off_slide
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Does every text frame keep the 0.5 in margin (margin)?
items.source: qa_render.MARGIN_IN = 0.5; Pitch margins and gaps (plan §6)
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Is no body text under the size floor (min_font: body 12 pt, caption 10 pt, title 28 pt)?
items.source: theme.Scale body_floor 12, caption_floor 10, title_min 28; docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §6.2; Pitch 28-32 px body is 14-16 pt (plan §2.4)
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Does every run meet WCAG contrast (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large) where colours are known (contrast)?
items.source: qa_render.py contrast (WCAG 2.x)
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Is there no left-over filler ([Agency], lorem, TBD, XXX) on a presented slide?
items.source: qa_render.py placeholder (FILLER)
items.na_when: qa.json is missing (a --no-qa run) or its only finding is 'unreadable' under the key 'deck'

items.question: Is no presented slide blank or almost empty (mostly_empty)?
items.source: qa_render.EMPTY_WARN 0.02, EMPTY_ERROR 0.004
items.na_when: qa.json has no 'pixels' entries (no PDF: summary.notes says 'pixels skipped')

items.question: Does no presented slide sit its content in one corner (one_corner)?
items.source: qa_render.CORNER_SHARE 0.8
items.na_when: qa.json has no 'pixels' entries (no PDF: summary.notes says 'pixels skipped')

items.question: Was no presented slide drawn by the fallback flow (its layout raised NoFit and the flow drew it)?
items.source: render_pptx.py 'Safe fallback'; Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md slice 4 done-when (5): fallback count to zero or each listed
items.na_when: no layout record: neither deck.slides.<id>.layout (slice 4) nor layouts.json (this slice) is in the run folder; or the deck was drawn with the classic theme (every slide is flow by theme, recorded as theme: classic)

items.question: Did the rules give every presented slide a library layout (choose_layout never returned flow)?
items.source: render_pptx.choose_layout's last rule; docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §3.1 (flow is reserved: no library layout)
items.na_when: no layout record: neither deck.slides.<id>.layout (slice 4) nor layouts.json (this slice) is in the run folder

items.question: Was no presented slide set relaxed (body text let down to the caption floor to fit)?
items.source: Renderer._relaxed; docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §3.1 layout.fit.relaxed
items.na_when: no layout record: neither deck.slides.<id>.layout (slice 4) nor layouts.json (this slice) is in the run folder

items.question: Are there never more than 2 identical content layouts in a row among presented slides?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §2.1 picker rules and §6 (Pitch teardown: no more than two alike in a row); reserved check layout_repeat
items.na_when: no layout record: neither deck.slides.<id>.layout (slice 4) nor layouts.json (this slice) is in the run folder; or fewer than 3 presented content slides

items.question: Does every window of 10 presented slides use at least 6 distinct layouts (ceil(0.6 x n) for a deck of n < 10)?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §2.1: Pitch's 10-slide template uses 8 distinct layouts; the checklist asks 6 in 10 (teardown evidence pitch_tpl_1440.measure.json)
items.na_when: no layout record: neither deck.slides.<id>.layout (slice 4) nor layouts.json (this slice) is in the run folder; or fewer than 5 presented slides

items.question: Is every presented slide's layout one of the library's (spec.LAYOUT_IDS) or flow, never invented?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md decision 9 (closed catalogue of at most 40); docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md rule 8; reserved check layout_unknown
items.na_when: no layout record: neither deck.slides.<id>.layout (slice 4) nor layouts.json (this slice) is in the run folder

items.question: Does every presented content slide have at most one dominant visual?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §6 (Pitch: one dominant visual); layout.schema.json slot.dominant
items.na_when: no layout library on disk (engine/deck/layouts/, deck-layout-library): no slot is marked dominant, so it cannot be judged

items.question: Does every presented content slide offer at least one alternative layout a person could swap to?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §2.1 alternatives, §6 (Beautiful.ai offers several per slide); docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §3.1
items.na_when: no slide records layout.alternatives (written by deck-layout-library)

items.question: Is every slot within its limits and bound (no slot_limit, slot_missing, slot_unknown, block_unbound, slot_stale)?
items.source: docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §3.3 binding rules
items.na_when: no slide has slots, or while the check name it reads is still in spec.RESERVED_CHECKS (no code raises it yet)

items.question: Is every presented slide within its slide type's word budget (no word_budget finding)?
items.source: spec.SLIDE_TYPES words; validate.word_budget
items.na_when: validation.json is missing or is not a list

items.question: Is every presented content slide at or under the deck's density target (lean 30, standard 60, detailed: the type budget)?
items.source: spec.DENSITY_WORDS {lean: 30, standard: 60}; Sai 2026-11-17 (docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §10, §11.6); teardown: the leaders' content slides carry about 30 words (Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §6)
items.na_when: deck.meta.preferences.density is absent: the build applied no density (the engine does not apply it until deck-layout-library), so a target the build did not aim at is not judged

items.question: Is the presented story within spec.PITCH_MAX (18) slides (no pitch_length finding)?
items.source: spec.PITCH_MAX = 18; validate.pitch_length
items.na_when: validation.json is missing or is not a list

items.question: Is every presented title a full-sentence takeaway (no action_title finding)?
items.source: validate.action_title
items.na_when: validation.json is missing or is not a list

items.question: Is no presented body text set in a column wider than 4.9 in when it runs to more than one line?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §2.1 max_line_in 4.9 (Pitch keeps body lines to 700 px of its 1920 px canvas = 4.86 in); reserved check line_length
items.na_when: deck.pptx is missing or cannot be opened

items.question: What share of presented content slides carry 30 words or fewer (validate.words: title, labelled placeholders and ad copy excluded)?
items.source: spec.DENSITY_WORDS lean 30; teardown about 30 words (Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §6 'One measured gap')
items.na_when: no presented content slide

items.question: What share of presented content slides carry 60 words or fewer?
items.source: spec.DENSITY_WORDS standard 60 (Sai 2026-11-17)
items.na_when: no presented content slide

items.question: What is the median word count of presented content slides?
items.source: same count as validate.words
items.na_when: no presented content slide

items.question: Across presented slides of one layout, is the title in one place and one size (top and left within 0.05 in, size within 1 pt)?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §1 step 12 and §6 (Pitch teardown: title_drift); reserved check title_drift
items.na_when: no layout record: neither deck.slides.<id>.layout (slice 4) nor layouts.json (this slice) is in the run folder; or deck.pptx is missing or cannot be opened; or no layout has 2 or more presented slides with a Title shape

items.question: Is every presented content-slide title set between the floor and the top of the title role (28 to 44 pt)?
items.source: docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §6.2 title role 36-44 pt, title_min 28; Pitch 72-88 px titles = 36-44 pt (plan §2.4)
items.na_when: deck.pptx is missing or cannot be opened

items.question: Is the cover title set at 60 pt or more?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §2.4 and §6: Pitch's cover title is 120-160 px = 60-80 pt, against today's display 44; docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §6.2 display 44-80
items.na_when: deck.pptx is missing or cannot be opened; or no presented slide of type title

items.question: Do presented slides use at most two font families?
items.source: Claude outputs/deck-maker-plan.md §6 (Pitch: two font families at most); docs/contracts/deck-visuals.md §6.2 fonts head and body
